paperInfo.subject: Family and Religious Studies
paperInfo.copyrightNote: Original practice questions synthesized from syllabus themes and recurring ZIMSEC-style patterns; not verbatim reproduction of past papers.
paperInfo.sourceBasis: ZIMSEC O-Level Family and Religious Studies 4047/02 listing and syllabus themes.

questions.questionText: Marriage is commonly understood in many religious traditions as
questions.explanation: Many traditions view marriage as a committed relationship with duties and obligations.

questions.questionText: Which factor can contribute to family breakdown?
questions.explanation: Unresolved conflict can weaken relationships and family stability.

questions.questionText: Responsible parenthood includes

options.text: Meeting children's physical, emotional and educational needs

questions.explanation: Responsible parenting addresses multiple dimensions of children's wellbeing.

questions.questionText: Which is an example of gender equality?

options.text: Giving people equal opportunities regardless of gender
Paying unequal wages for equal work

questions.explanation: Equality means opportunities and rights are not unfairly restricted by gender.

questions.questionText: A community can support families by
questions.explanation: Community structures can provide support, protection and services.

questions.questionText: Which action is most consistent with stewardship of the environment?
questions.explanation: Stewardship involves responsible care of resources and the environment.

questions.questionText: A religious leader may contribute to society by

options.text: Teaching ethical principles and supporting reconciliation

questions.explanation: Religious leaders can provide moral guidance and help communities reconcile conflicts.

questions.questionText: Which is a likely consequence of substance abuse in a family?
questions.explanation: Substance abuse can affect health, finances and relationships.

questions.explanation: Dignity requires respect for the worth and rights of people.

questions.explanation: Dialogue and respect help communities live together peacefully.
